meta_description: I.B Coatings is a trusted painter and decorator in Newcastle. Interior and exterior work, free quotes, reliable service. Call today.
hero_eyebrow: Professional Painter & Decorator — Newcastle's Local Choice
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior decorating tailored to your home. Free quotes, reliable work, finished on time.
services_subhead: From fresh interior walls to full exterior transformations, we handle every project with care and attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Decoration
services.desc: Complete interior redecoration, from single rooms to whole houses. We prepare surfaces properly, apply quality finishes, and leave you with a space that looks and lasts.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weatherproof your home with durable exterior paint work. We treat woodwork, uPVC, and masonry to withstand Newcastle's climate and keep your property looking fresh for years.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Professional sanding, staining, and painting of doors, frames, skirting, and bespoke joinery. Every detail counts, and we finish to a standard that shows.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Work
services.desc: Add character to your rooms with feature walls, faux finishes, or specialist paint effects. We create focal points that transform how a space feels.

services.title: Commercial & Residential Repaints
services.desc: Whether you're refreshing a rental, preparing a home for sale, or updating a commercial property, we work efficiently without disrupting your routine.

services.title: Surface Preparation & Repairs
services.desc: Proper prep is everything. We assess and repair cracks, fill holes, sand surfaces, and prime as needed — the foundation of a flawless finish.

about_pullquote: Quality paintwork should last — we don't cut corners.
about_para_1: I.B Coatings was founded with a simple belief: that good decorating isn't about speed, it's about skill and respect for your home. Over 12 years, we've built our reputation one project at a time across Byker, Gateshead, and the broader Newcastle area. Every job, whether a single bedroom or a full house exterior, receives the same attention to detail and professional approach.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen, we show up on time, and we deliver finishes that last. We use quality materials, prepare surfaces properly, and take pride in the work we leave behind. When you book I.B Coatings, you're working with a local painter who understands your home and respects your investment.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About I.B Coatings

reviews.text: Had our whole house redecorated inside and out. Lads were tidy, professional, and finished when they said they would. Paint work is spotless — you can tell they take pride in what they do. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Contacted for a free quote on our kitchen and lounge. Came round quickly, gave us a fair price, and the work was done to a really high standard. No mess, no faffing about. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Susan H.

reviews.text: Exterior needed doing before winter. Impressed with how thoroughly they prepped everything — cracks filled, woodwork sanded, primer applied properly. The finish is excellent and we've had a few neighbours ask for the number.
reviews.author: Michael T.
